preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The size of the array A for each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= A[i] < N for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element of the array A must be either -1 or a non-negative integer less than N.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not exists_valid_permutation else True
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, the output must be -1.
If a valid permutation exists, the output must be the lexicographically smallest permutation as a space-separated string.
